title: A Quiet Evening
setting: a room at night: a table in the middle with a lamp on top of it, and a chair just left of the table, all in the back layer.
shots: A stick man sits on the chair beside the table, facing the table, and sighs.
Still sitting, he looks at the lamp.
A red ball rolls in from the right and stops on the floor near the table.
He gets a fright, then stands up, walks to the ball, picks it up and puts it on the table next to the lamp.
He turns to face the camera and waves.
camera: show the whole room, then zoom in a little during the final wave.
